termsOfUse.title: TeRms oF uSe OF ThE sItE
termsOfUse.quote: You can play the keys however you want. But you want something good to come out of it, right? So here are a few rules. Read them before you start improvising.
termsOfUse.archiveUsage: When using archival materials in scientific, public or media projects, a reference to the source with an active hyperlink to the Foundation's website is mandatory.
termsOfUse.paidNotes: Some of the sheet music may be paid for. In such cases, there will be a button on the page of the relevant work to request access.
termsOfUse.copyrightRespect: We urge you to be careful about copyright. If you use materials from this site in publications or other projects, please indicate the source with a hyperlink to the Foundation's website.
termsOfUse.behaviorIntro: Our site does not allow for user comments or content posting. However, we ask that you:
termsOfUse.respectAuthorsIntro: We sincerely thank you for your interest in Ukrainian music and the figure of Borys Liatoshynsky. Please be careful with the works you use. Respect for copyright is not only a legal issue, but also an ethical norm.
termsOfUse.respectAuthorsOutro: By preserving and distributing them responsibly, we, together with you, support the culture of memory and the modern sound of Ukrainian classics.
termsOfUse.libraryAccessTitle: Access to the music library and archive:
termsOfUse.copyrightTitle: Copyright and the role of the UAASP:
termsOfUse.concertLicense: If you are the organizer of a concert or are planning to broadcast Liatoshynsky's works, contact the UAASP to obtain the appropriate license by email.
termsOfUse.subscribeNews: subscribe to the Foundation's newsletter (concerts, updates, events, etc.).
termsOfUse.noSharing: not to transfer access to downloaded materials to third parties;
termsOfUse.noPublicPosting: not to make the received notes and/or archival documents publicly available on other resources without the consent of the Foundation.

ourPartners.title: OUR PARTNERS:
ourPartners.description: The Liatoshynsky Foundation is sincerely open to partnership and appreciates any support. We believe that cooperation based on trust and mutual respect will help us develop Ukrainian musical culture together. We invite those who share our mission and seek to participate in preserving the legacy of Borys Liatoshynsky and supporting contemporary musical initiatives to partner with us.
